annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Pulling the lever would trade one death for five
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: acting here only makes things worse, so that instinct doesn't hold
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help however they'd let me, starting with the funeral arrangements

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people would die if I moved it
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: That rule assumes the change is an improvement. Here it isn't
annotations.pda_repair_intention: sit down with the worker's crew and explain my choice

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Switching would devastate five families instead of one.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the other track were clear, I'd move that lever in a heartbeat.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer real help: paperwork, meals, getting them answers
annotations.ce_understood_harm: devastate five families instead of one

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: It's one life lost versus five
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: stepping in means making things better, not rerouting the danger
annotations.pda_repair_intention: start a collection among the crew for the worker's family

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: switching kills five workers to spare one
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: standing by is the less harmful move when the only alternative is deadlier
annotations.pda_responsibility: My job afterward is to own it.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write to the worker's family explaining exactly what happened

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: It just hands the disaster to five people instead of one.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the lever sent the train somewhere empty, doing nothing would be indefensible.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: volunteer to testify at any inquiry

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five dead is worse than one dead
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: My rule of doing what I can bends when the only thing I can do adds deaths
annotations.pda_repair_intention: asking what practical help they need

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Switching would do the opposite, losing five to save one.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: only makes sense when intervening improves the result
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help them get the support services they're entitled to
annotations.sys_rule_justification: In triage we act fast to save as many people as we can.
annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: it's not a close call for me

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five workers don't go home instead of one
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I had real doubt the five were there
annotations.pda_repair_intention: push the company to cover their costs in full

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: multiply the loss for more families and more coworkers
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: When the rescue costs five lives, it stops being a rescue.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: helping organize whatever memorial or fund the crew wants
